units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 12:29">Targ. Ex. XII, 29</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bava Batra 126b:10">B. Bath. 126ᵇ</cite> <he>ב׳ סכלא</he> (h. <he>בכור שוטה</he>) foolish (wild) first-born, i.e. a first-born by his mother but not by his father (having no privileges).—Pl. <cite ref="B00251"><he>בּוּכְרַיָּא</he></cite>, <he>בּוּכְרִין</he>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 135:8">Targ. Ps. CXXXV, 8</cite>; a. e.—Fem. <he>בּוּכְרְתָא</he>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 6a:6">Ber. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>ב׳ בת ב׳</he> a first-born cat whose mother is a first-born.—[
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 33:14">Targ. Y. I Deut. XXXIII, 14</cite>. (Targ. Y. II. <cite ref="B00796"><he>בִּכְרָא</he></cite>).]
